quality.note: quality = 100 - sum(weight[b] * gap[b]). gap is how far below the best candidate a model is on benchmark b, in percent of the best for accuracy benchmarks and in percent of win probability for Elo boards.

korean.note: For Korean the Text Arena gap is the mean of the overall and Korean-slice gaps, where the model has a Korean-slice rating.

output.note: With an output chosen, quality = (1 - share) * task quality + share * (100 - gap on the output's own benchmark).

reliability.note: Carried per model from the 6 Oct 2026 edition. A model without one takes the lowest carried value, so a model nobody has measured never outranks one that has been and the pick is marked partly estimated. On Redrob Cowork it falls by 15% times the share of the task's tools that are connectors, which Redrob Cowork reaches through MCP rather than natively.

speed.note: Carried per model. A model without one: 41.68 * ln(median output tokens per second) - 147.28, the fit of the carried values to Artificial Analysis throughput, clamped to 0..100.

cost.note: 100 * (ln max - ln c) / (ln max - ln min), c the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index cost per task at the ranked effort, against the cheapest and dearest model on that board. Reproduces the 6 Oct edition's cost score for every model but Sonnet 5.5.

monthly.note: runs * task cost per run * model cost per run at the effort * language factor (+ images). Model factors are carried from the 6 Oct edition; a model without one scales Opus 5.5's by the ratio of Artificial Analysis cost per task. Range is half to double.

ci.note: Half-width of the 95% interval on the total: the weight on quality times the weighted mean of each benchmark's own interval, as a gap.

benchmarkPicks.note: Shown greyed when they would make the top five, beside the pick they compare with, taking no slot.

redrob.note: On Redrob Cowork a model runs only at the thinking levels Redrob serves it at (snapshots/redrob/<date>.json, from Console GET /v1/pricing), so it is ranked at its own ranked level when Redrob serves that, else at the highest served level below it. A model Redrob serves with no adjustable level runs at its provider default, read as providerDefault. A model with no Redrob id is ranked as before and cannot be switched to from the guide.
